1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto caducifolio de hasta 8 m de altura, muy ramificado, con ramillas colgantes, espinosas, hojas alternas con bordes finamente dentados, inflorescencia axilar y flores amarillo verdosas. (Rhamnaceae; Zizyphus jujuba).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Deciduous shrub reaching up to 8 m in height, highly branched, with hanging, spiny branches, alternate leaves with finely toothed margins, axillary inflorescence and yellow-green flowers (Rhamnaceae; Zizyphus jujuba).
